title: Hohe Salve Hopfgarten Panoramaberg
highlights: Blick auf ueber 70 Dreitausender von den Hohen Tauern bis zum Wilden Kaiser
Hoechstgelegene Wallfahrtskirche Oesterreichs: Das Salvenkirchlein Johannes der Taeufer
Drehbare Panoramaterrasse und Windharfe direkt am Berggipfel
kurzbeschreibung: At 1,829 metres, Hohe Salve near Hopfgarten offers a magnificent 360-degree panorama of over 70 three-thousand-metre peaks and the Salvenkirchlein.
beschreibung:
The Most Beautiful Panoramic Mountain in the Kitzbüheler Alpen

Hohe Salve rises strikingly as a conical panoramic peak above the Brixental. Thanks to its standalone position, its 1,829-metre summit opens up one of the most spectacular circular vistas in the Eastern Alps, overlooking the Grossglockner, Grossvenediger, and the Kaisergebirge.

Salvenkirchlein and Sundial Trail

Perched upon the summit plateau stands the historic pilgrimage chapel of St. Johann Baptist, Austria's highest church. Along the panoramic trail, interactive sundials and a wind harp invite visitors to discover the elemental forces of nature in a playful way.
